notes.title: Hindenburg VR version 1.2
notes.notes:
Added:
1. Disaster Scene
2. Voiceover
3. Fixed some textures (duralumin girders, ...)
4. Few minor fixes
Warning, Disaster Scene causing distress and vertigo !

Notice for Viveport users, version 1.2 is "Waiting for Review"

notes.title: Hindenburg VR version 1.1
notes.notes:
Added:
1. Main Menu
2. Night scene, Flashlight only
3. RC Mini Simulator game
4. Three Quality settings
5. Crash scene (coming soon)
6. Few PickUp objects (Cigar, Map, Ticket, Menu)

Fixed:
1. Teleport Offset
2. Teleport Aim Line
3. Few minor fixes

Changed:
1. Teleport button, now is Left Trackpad UP (10m limit)
2. Free Step, now is Left Trackpad DOWN (step 50cm)
3. HELP, now is Left Trigger
